mechanism: Methimazole may cause agranulocytosis and immunosuppression, potentially increasing infection risk in patients with sildenafil-induced vasodilation and altered hemodynamics; both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism but no significant CYP450 competition occurs.
action: Monitor for signs of infection and agranulocytosis (sore throat, fever); ensure adequate hematologic monitoring while on methimazole; use sildenafil cautiously in hyperthyroid patients with cardiovascular instability.
